title: ASC 250 Error Correction - DemoCo Accrued Hosting Fees, FY2024-FY2025
conclusionSummary: Hosting fees of 15,000.00 USD (FY2024) and 10,000.00 USD (FY2025) were never accrued. The cumulative 25,000.00 USD misstatement is 6.25% of FY2025 pretax income under the iron-curtain method (the largest single-year effect is 3.75% under rollover); with the qualitative factors considered the error is material and is corrected by restatement as of 2026-01-01.
